items.text: Send a short message with roughly what you have — "a one-bedroom flat" or "twenty boxes and a bicycle" is plenty. We will tell you which size fits.
items.title: Tell us what you are storing

items.text: We would rather you saw the actual room than a photograph. Come during office hours; no appointment needed.
items.title: Come and see the unit

items.text: Monthly rolling, one month's notice. We will explain anything you want explained before you sign.
items.title: Sign a one-page agreement

items.text: You buy or bring the padlock and you keep the only key. We do not hold a copy.
items.title: Fit your own padlock

items.text: Access seven days a week. Bring what you need, take what you want, no notice required.
items.title: Come and go

text: Give us a month's notice, empty the unit, take your padlock off, and that is it. We do not charge a cleaning fee for a unit left swept.
